response.overview: Oxford, 2013. Frances Schumacher, a brilliant, ambitious PhD student crosses paths with a Bitcoin-obsessed fraternity boy, and together, they set out to revolutionize the financial world. What begins as a vision of unimaginable wealth soon spirals into one of the most audacious financial frauds in American history, where genius, greed, and the art of selling a lie become virtually indistinguishable.
response.tagline: MAKE BILLIONS OF DOLLARS. MAKE BILLIONS OF ENEMIES.
response.title: Frances Coin
